title: Independent electronic-structure investigation of substituted azo molecules
difficulty_reasons: The molecular set and observables are fixed, while the Agent must formulate and test an electronic explanation and justify method/conformer choices.

paper.title: Substituent-Driven Electronic Modulation of Azo Bond: Enabling the Design of Ultrafast and Exceptionally Sensitive Fluorescent Probe for Hypoxia

data.description: Explicit canonical SMILES and state/mapping definitions for two neutral closed-shell azo molecules.

required_deliverables.description: Structured independent calculations, tested explanation, validation, and limitations.
